exposure: type of vehicle ridden during MVC (scooter vs. car)
cohort: 20,844 pregnant women involved in MVCs and 83,274 matched controls from the National Birth Notification Database in Taiwan
finding: Pregnant women involved in MVCs were at increased risk of placental abruption, prolonged uterine contractions, antepartum hemorrhage, and caesarean delivery compared to controls.
mod_finding: The study found an increased risk of cesarean delivery in pregnant women involved in MVCs.
